edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument into _transfer
block.timestamp is read and written into the cooldown mapping, creating timestamp dependency
_transfer compares cooldown[to] against block.timestamp to gate buys
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading
External swapTokensForEth call executes before token state is updated in _tokenTransfer
sendETHToFee external ETH transfer is invoked after the swap inside the transfer path
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard
_transfer reads the bots blacklist before allowing the transfer
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount on buys
_transferStandard subtracts/credits _rOwned for sender and recipient
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team fee
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection fee
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues
_takeTeam credits rTeam into _rOwned[address(this)]
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal by rFee
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee
swapTokensForEth calls the stored uniswapV2Router
swapTokensForEth performs an external swap call while holding token state
sendETHToFee sends half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet1
sendETHToFee sends half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet2
sendETHToFee performs native ETH transfers to destinations controlled by fee wallet state
openTrading assigns the hardcoded router to uniswapV2Router
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the whole contract ETH balance
openTrading enables automatic swaps via swapEnabled
openTrading enables the cooldown via cooldownEnabled
openTrading sets the new _maxTxAmount for buys
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the contract balance
manualswap authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet1 (msg.sender check)
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
manualsend authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet1 (msg.sender check)

_getValues calls _getRate to derive the current rate

_getValues reads _feeAddr2 for team fee computation
balanceOf converts _rOwned[account] through tokenFromReflection
transferFrom routes the value movement through _transfer

setFeeAmountOne writes _feeAddr1 after an owner plus wallet2 authorization check
setFeeAmountTwo writes _feeAddr2 after an owner plus wallet2 authorization check

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to supply the sender address used inside _transfer
The to parameter only exists to supply the recipient address used inside _transfer
The amount parameter is only consumed by _transfer flow and its checks
Local balance snapshot computed inside _transfer to size the swap
The bots_ array parameter is only iterated within setBots to write the bots mapping
The local path array exists only to route the swap inside swapTokensForEth
